title: Setup → Sessions: the revoked-session view keeps the 'Active user sessions' subtitle and the active-only toolbar action (sys_session metadata)
body:
domain:ui#2 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5oF8GgTHN2jBZoDwz8

Filing gate: ② out-of-scope finding, class a, from #33346 row 246 (PR #33547; os-dev-report 6886439582, `out_of_scope_findings[0]`; seat ruling 6885601326: no ui-side special case). ⛔ Not a claim; triage sets the lane and grade.
Dedupe: `is:issue is:open sys_session revoked` finds only #33346.

## What the user sees

Setup → Sessions, revoked view: the page keeps the subtitle "Active user sessions" and the active-session toolbar button, which belong to the active view.

## Why (read on `origin/main` `e3f0cfd4` by the #33346 dev)

- The subtitle is the session object's OBJECT description: `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-session.object.ts` ~L63.
- The button is an object-level `list_toolbar` action with no view scoping: same file ~L74-79.
- The console renders an object's description on every view by design (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/.../objectViewPageHeader.tsx` ~L145), so the fix is in the object's metadata (a neutral description, and the action scoped to the active view), not in the console.

## Acceptance

- The revoked-session view shows no "active" subtitle or active-only toolbar action; the active view is unchanged.
